body.message:
Hello! I came across a few of Afifa Al Shami’s listings on Bayut for 2-bedroom apartments with a maid’s room in City Walk. We’re looking to rent from August 20 to September 17 and would be very interested in discussing the available options and hopefully securing one.

I tried reaching out to Afifa directly but haven’t heard back yet, so I thought I’d contact you here. Would you be able to assist us, please?
